notes.title: Developer Notes: Dynamic Difficulty, Clothing customization, X-Ray and more!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We have news regarding some updates and features we are working on. Please be aware that everything here is W.I.P (Work In Progress)

This week, we will briefly discuss Dynamic Difficulty, Specific Clothing Customization, X-rays, Pools, and night time.

[h2]Dynamic Difficulty[/h2]

Simply put, Lily will be a bit more challenging the better you play the game. If you are on a losing streak, she will become easier.

Lily's AI logic will also be improved, making her AI logic, stun resistance, and movement smoother and more dynamic. 

Also, she will have better path-finding logic, avoiding getting stuck in a collision that she should typically be able to go over.

[h2]Specific Clothing Customization[/h2]

You will be able to remove specific parts of clothes. 

The idea is that you can mix and match outfits. For example, if you want a Santa hat on your bunny outfit, you can. The current implementation is that you can remove specific clothing so she can be half-naked rather than full-naked. For example, you can do that if you want her to be in a maid outfit but just with the maid top + glasses and nude elsewhere.

[h2]X-Ray[/h2]

Many users like this taste in doujin/hentai, so we are also implementing it.

We will let the GIF do the talking:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038861/914eb3b4b0d64105049f45ae3917669f67840c6c.gif[/img]

[h2]Pool[/h2]

A new area to escape Lily's gaze will be added. Maybe a new bikini for Lily?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038861/9deabfa76e2d3df9d128bdaa40ac14598732fa11.gif[/img]


[h2]Night Time[/h2]

We are also testing some settings to have the game running at night. This is very W.I.P, but let us know what you think:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038861/df4eea2c0cdb4192d2e6ed8a380adb17f384eb0f.png[/img]

[h1]What about performance?[/h1]

Next week, we will have a dedicated blog post talking more about the optimization of Unreal 5, the tests we do here with multiple hardware, testing the game on Steam Deck, and also how we are rewriting the code, which can also save stress of performance in numerous PC setups.

Stay tuned next week!

- Erommersion Team

notes.title: I hope you're as excited as I am!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! I want to start by thanking everybody for their support. Genuinely, you've allowed us to work on something we're truly passionate about.

We’re thrilled to report that we’ve been added to over 1500 wishlists in less than 4 months! 

It's crazy to think that 1500 unique Players would be interested in our small little game. To think that an idea that spawned out of frustration about the Adult Content industry here on Steam has made it this far. Since this is the first game we've made together we didn't know what to expect. But thank you so much for the support. 

Currently, we're improving existing ideas and implementing exciting new ones to bring you the best experience possible. Here is a sneak peek at an addition to the taser equipment to assist in your journey of escaping Lily's Labyrinth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038861/47624e2b0961345a9a73b54f4f2c3625d8eef7c4.gif[/img]

[h3]Please Let us know if it should be implemented upon the Impact of the taser. OR used as a different item entirely.[/h3]

[h2]What we're doing next[/h2]
Right now there are a lot of bugs. Our Patreon supporters have playtested an older dev build and we've heard all of your feedback. We're working on optimization, giving the player the option to disable lumen and DLSS and adding FSR compatibility for those using AMD graphics cards. And most importantly adding more NSFW works.

[/b]

Please follow us and wishlist here to receive news on future updates including additional characters, drones, our new NSFW build and much much more!
